title: From partial permutation information to Fourier bounds
coverage:
I read introduction.tex, foundations.tex and core.tex in full. These contain the whole proof of Theorem 1.1 and of Corollaries 3.3 and 3.6, the headline 2-convolution result. I checked line by line:
- Lemma 2.1 (degree sums): the bound log p(k) <= 3 sqrt k; the bound #SYT >= binom(a,j); the dominated-convergence range j <= n/3; the exponential ranges a >= n/10 and a < n/10 via the hook bound (5/e)^n.
- Lemma 2.2 (partition selection).
- Lemma 2.3 (sequential and simultaneous trimming; the c-thresholded conditioning and its TV identity).
- Lemma 2.4 (Plancherel with a mass deficit).
- Prop 2.5 (amplification; sign and missing-mass handling).
- Lemma 3.1 (orbit dimension is independent of multiplicity).
- Prop 3.2 (orbit-span): least-index assignment, the Schur averaging E_U rho(g)Pi rho(g)* = (dim W/D)I, the coset-cap use, Cauchy-Schwarz and the sqrt b factor.
- Lemma 3.4: the central idempotent is the isotypic projection; the left-coset support of f*e matches the convention f(gH); per-coset L2 bound; sum_Q f(Q)^2 <= Bz/[G:H].
- Prop 3.5 (projection cover I <= sum P, traced against Fhat*Fhat).
- Exponent arithmetic: -1+3/8 = -5/8, 1-2(5/8) = -1/4, 2-8(5/16) = -1/2.
I also checked that the coset convention matches the abstract ("images of 7n/8 labels" = left cosets of Sym(M), |M| = n/8). I did not audit the later extension sections 4-15 or the appendices. Those concern alternative or companion-dependent transfers and are not needed for the main theorem or corollary.
main_claim: If f >= 0 has mass at most 1 and satisfies the coset caps f(gH_i) <= B/[G:H_i] for a partition of the labels into b blocks, then every irreducible rho of degree D has ||fhat(rho)||_HS^2 <= b B C_u D^{-1+(u+2)/b}. As a consequence, take n a multiple of 8 and let mu_n be laws on S_n whose images of a random 7n/8 labels are o(1)-close to uniform on average and whose sign mean is o(1). Then mu_n * mu_n converges to uniform in total variation.
sibling_notes: The board for family 238 was empty when I checked. No sibling reports existed, so it did not affect this review.
